descriptors.path: owned basename only; independent verifier must refuse traversal/symlink/duplicate/inventory mismatch
descriptors.sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits; producer report must be independently authenticated

external_acceptance_gates: exact generated and unchanged source closure
protected full role/input membership and no candidate exposure to capture
separate native saved-product MAT body schema when present
all output file inventory/identity and parent-directory durability
original phase clock and independent natural-zero closure after all cleanup
all unresolved helpers, data/identity/producers and ED obligations retained

footer.bytes_reserved_before_footer: raw and metadata write reservations plus maximum native cache reservation; no refund
footer.files_before_footer: all successfully reserved output names before footer; expected closed inventory adds footer, but this producer count is not independent evidence
footer.native_cache: present false, or original_native_save_MAT with path/bytes/SHA and body_schema_admitted false
footer.snapshots: ordered descriptor list, sequence1..N includes workspace snapshots and value taps

leaf.empty: zero bytes and exact empty hash allowed
leaf.extent_equation: bytes == product(shape) * primitive_bytes_per_element[class], using bounded exact integer arithmetic
leaf.floating_nonfinite: preserved in raw payload; never literal nonfinite JSON numbers
leaf.logical_wire: uint8 0/1; body validity separate from extent
leaf.shape: exact nonnegative integer dimensions; scalar MATLAB shape is[1,1]; unknown until authenticated capture

node_types.categorical_codes_and_categories: typed double codes/categories and ordinal flag; undefined codes remain raw NaN
node_types.cell_column_major: class/originalshape, flat row-vector values in MATLAB linear element order
node_types.declared_native_model_property_projectio: fixed public property list with explicit absent-property statuses; not private model serialization
node_types.graphics_handle_explicitly_excluded: class/shape only; separate fixed graphic property projection at root return
node_types.native_model_array_column_major: originalshape plus flat elementwise supported model projections
node_types.source_bound_function_handle_description: expression and exposed closure workspace; executable handle not serialized
node_types.sparse_triplets_column_major: class/originalshape plus typed row,column,values; complete matrix-value/schema validation needs body admission
node_types.string_elements_UTF8_with_missing_mask: class/originalshape, typed missing logical mask, flat UTF8 leaves or explicit missing_string; no fabricated replacement value
node_types.struct_column_major: class/originalshape, field_order, flat values with element-major then field-order grouping
node_types.table_columns: typed columns in variable_order plus row/dimension names, units, descriptions, user_data and all enumerated custom properties; timetable row_time classes may be unsupported

per_root_schema_gate: Parent must admit actual full numerical outputs/support and scientific role classification before run; static assigned_names are not mandatory-presence/shape proof

ach_native_snapshot_v1.graphics_numeric: only root_return; fixed property projection of fresh-worker graphics, not rendering parity
ach_native_snapshot_v1.workspace: map of actual original variable names to typed nodes; workspace_variable_order records actual whos order
ach_native_snapshot_v1.workspace_whos_bytes: reported logical extent only, not process memory

ach_native_value_tap_v1.value: typed node of one original evaluation, returned unchanged to its caller

unsupported_class: Raises achcapture:unsupported_class, prevents accepted capture; no silent omission
